newsitem.title: USA: Advanced Media secures $100 mln financing.
newsitem.headline: Advanced Media secures $100 mln financing.

text.p: Advanced Media Inc said Monday it has signed a letter of intent to secure asset financing in an initial amount of up to $100 million.
The finance facility will be used as part of a multimedia and Internet strategy that is to be revealed in the next week in conjunction with an undisclosed computer services company.
The credit facility is expected to be closed in the next three to four weeks, it said. Further details will be released upon the closing, the company said.
Advanced Media creates and produces interactive multimedia and Internet products for business.
